claim: The Engine baseline splits tokenizer/API, scheduler, and detokenizer roles; launcher resolves and validates context before publication.
IPC structures define representation boundaries rather than all normalization/execution behavior.
get_model chooses a loader and delegates model installation with model/device configuration.
The default loader calls model.load_weights and alternate loaders must preserve post-load fixup contracts.
Qwen2 contains stacked projection mappings for selected checkpoint weight installation.
Frontend request state is initialized before tokenization/dispatch, and failure handling distinguishes undelivered and dispatched state.
Normal and overlap loops use NextBatchPlan; overlap queues batch.copy with results and separates previous-result processing from current sampling.
The WAR barrier consumes shared_read_done_event and enqueues schedule-stream waits on the fine event or forward stream fallback.
Batch preparation transforms request progress and KV mappings into extend/decode execution metadata while respecting overlap references.
Prefill admission tracks resource budgets separately from candidate ordering.
Node splitting clones KV-index vector slices, not model KV payload tensors; lock references protect shared ancestry.
ReqToTokenPool reserves row zero, increments allocation generations, and preserves generations across clear.
free_segment requires page-aligned starts and grouped page release owns copied page representatives.
The worker constructs ForwardBatch for ModelRunner, with selected transformed-batch paths.
Filtering retains per-request row-aligned sampling metadata.
Incremental text production retains decoder offsets/context rather than independently concatenating decoded token strings.
Repeated load timestamps are ignored and control fan-out iterates the stepped active-worker set.
PoolTransferResult can describe nonmonotonic restorable prefix boundaries whose per-rank sets must be intersected.
KVPoll distinguishes failed, bootstrap, waiting, transferring, and success states.
StagingAllocator overcommits ring rounds; remote writes require the oldest-unfreed watermark safety protocol.
Full-pool accounting sums available, evictable, protected, session-held, and uncached state and separately enforces other invariants.
Request timing structures distinguish frontend/controller/scheduler/delivery measurement boundaries.
Named salt-slicing and page-aligned-match tests assert key-view compatibility and rounded usable matches.
Shared-read event tests distinguish event publication and disabled/incompatible paths.
Named tests keep failed destinations unpublished and wait for required rank completion.
Aborted final results do not publish successful ready state.
Named timeout tests preserve unset timing, suppress repeated outstanding aborts, and retain queued results after newer forward launches.
Named tests cover conserved/skewed pool ownership and detection of one unowned page.
Release-step test restricts which coordination paths may execute a release step.
